shop.name: ENJZ
shop.description: Original Arabic poetry transformed into limited edition visual art by Lebanese poet Zein Sourany. Not calligraphy — handwritten verse on Hahnemühle archival paper. Madrid.

lebanon-collection-لبنان.body:
Lebanon does not live in geography alone. It lives in how we love, in how we remember, in what remains when nothing remains.

This collection is not about the war, though the war is present in it. It is about a country that resembles the people we cannot move on from — complicated, wounding, indispensable.

I wrote these poems because I found no other way to carry what I carry. I turned them into visual works because words alone were no longer enough.

taraf-indulgence-ترف.body:
Indulgence dwells on emotional intensity rather than restraint. The pieces gathered here treat love, pain, longing and devotion not as passing states but as conditions willingly entered. Language becomes a place where feeling is allowed to overflow.

The texts resist simplification. They speak of endurance, tenderness and inner conflict, balancing vulnerability with resolve. The compositions carry that same tension through contrast, rhythm and selective emphasis.

Each work is made as a contemplative object — one that invites prolonged looking rather than quick consumption.

hors-serie.body: Pieces from words I wrote that refuse to sit inside a frame.

new-collection.body: The most recent pieces, still finding the company they belong to.

about_artist:
زين العابدين الصوراني

I am a Lebanese artist based in Madrid.

My work lives at the intersection of language, memory and form. I work primarily with Arabic text — not as calligraphy in the traditional sense, but as meaning. Letters treated as living material, carrying weight, silence and history.

I come to art from a life outside the studio. Years of work in complex, high-pressure environments taught me restraint, observation and the value of what is left unsaid. Creation, for me, is not escape; it is return.

I work by hand, then translate each piece into a physical object through carefully tested prints. Scale, texture and negative space matter as much as the words themselves. Each work is produced in limited quantities, with attention to how it lives on a wall, in light, and over time.

ENJZ is not a persona. It is a continuation — a way to give form to ideas that insist on being made visible.
why_enjz_ar:
ماذا تعني كلّ الاحتمالات عندما لا تستطيع الاختيار؟
ماذا يعني عالم مليء بالألوان عندما لا تستطيع أن تشرق الشمس؟
ماذا يعني الغد عندما تعيش في الأمس؟

"أنجِز"… كل أفكارك التي غطاها الغبار… كل مغامراتك التي عثرتها الأفكار… كل حبٍّ زرعته ولم يؤت ثمار…

"أنجِز"… هي قصة كل شخص قرر أن يعود إلى أحلام الطفولة حيث لا خوف من فشل أو إرهاق. حيث تصنع مخيلتك عوالم لا متناهية تكون فيها الفنان والطبيب والمهندس والحالم الولهان.
كبرنا جميعًا ووضعنا أفكارنا في لحظة ما في جعبة منسية وراء الباب. وجعلنا نطرق سبل الحياة متجاهلين تلك الجعبة… خائفين أن يرى الناس ماذا تحوي… نفكر بها وننكر وجودها وفي كل مرة نمرّ بجانبها، نتحسّر ونكمل المسير.

"أنجِز"… هي تلك الجعبة تعود على مكتبي بعد الأربعين. أفتحها، أُخرج ما بداخلها، ولا أخاف لوم اللائمين.

"أنجِز"… هو أن أبعث من جديد في يوم ليس لي، وليس لأحدٍ… أن أرى أنني أمسي وغدي، وأن العالم كبير ووسيع ولا حدود لمن يريد السبيل…

"أنجِز"… ليست ميدالية مشاركة دون ربح… وليست أملًا دون كدّ… هي إيمانٌ بعيون لا تبكي إلّا ما ندر. هي بلاد تختلط فيها كل عروق البشر… هو أن يحترق طائر الفينيق ليبعث في لغة الضاد في أرض الأندلس قبل أن يحين المغيب…
why_enjz_en:
What do all possibilities mean when you cannot choose?
What does a world full of colour mean when the sun cannot rise?
What does tomorrow mean when you live in yesterday?

Enjz — all your ideas covered in dust, all your adventures crippled by thoughts, all the love you planted that never bore fruit.

Enjz is the story of everyone who chose to return to childhood dreams, where there is no fear of failure or exhaustion, where imagination forges infinite worlds in which you are the artist, the doctor, the engineer, and the lovestruck dreamer.

We all grew up and, at some point, placed our ideas into a forgotten satchel behind the door. We went on knocking at life's doors, ignoring that satchel, afraid of what people might see inside it. We think of it, deny its existence, and each time we pass by it we sigh in regret and keep walking.

Enjz is that satchel returning to my desk after forty. I open it, take out what is inside, and do not fear the blame of those who blame.

Enjz is to be reborn on a day that belongs neither to me nor to anyone — to see that I am both my yesterday and my tomorrow, and that the world is vast and wide, with no limits for one who seeks the path.

Enjz is not a participation medal without victory, nor hope without toil. It is faith in eyes that rarely cry. It is a land where all human races intertwine. It is the phoenix burning so it may rise again in the language of Ḍād, on the land of al-Andalus, before sunset comes.
production:
Each work is an original giclée print on Hahnemühle archival fine art paper, signed and numbered by the artist. Editions are limited and run from A4 through A0, with the larger formats held in the smallest editions.

Nothing is held in stock. Each piece is produced after the conversation, which takes two to three weeks from the moment the edition and format are agreed. Works are supplied unframed. If a piece arrives damaged, it is replaced.
